hero.title: Moral Merry High School
hero.subtitle: Lighted to Lighten
hero.text: Values-based education from Nursery to Class 10 in the heart of Masab Tank, Hyderabad.

journey.heading: Our Journey
journey.text: Since 1980, Moral Merry High School has grown from a small community school into a trusted name in Masab Tank, Hyderabad. Our commitment to moral values, discipline and academic excellence has stayed unwavering through decades of growth.

campus.heading: Life at Moral Merry
campus.subtitle: Learning, celebrating and growing together every day

items.caption: Yoga and meditation for a calm, focused mind

items.title: Academic Excellence
items.text: A balanced curriculum from Nursery to Class 10, with smart classes and weekly assessments.

items.title: Sports & Fitness
items.text: Coaching in cricket, football, basketball and athletics, plus an annual sports meet.

items.title: Arts & Culture
items.text: Music, dance, drama, art and fancy-dress events that build confidence.

items.title: Yoga & Meditation
items.text: Regular yoga and meditation sessions help students stay calm and focused.

items.title: English Fluency
items.text: Daily speaking practice, with awards for excellent English communication.

items.title: Science Exhibitions
items.text: An annual science fair where students build and present their own projects.
